title: Prairie Engine Works
summary: Longlight's biggest game so far. Put an engine together on the test stand, fire it up and hear it run, then take it to the drag strip or a truck and tractor pull to earn cash and reputation.

title: Red Skies
summary: A phone game where you run an air-defence battery. Watch the radar, sort friendly jets from enemies, and hold your fire until you're sure, because shooting down a friendly ends the shift.

title: Penthouse Baccarat
summary: A 3D baccarat table in a penthouse overlooking the Shanghai skyline. Place your chips and an android croupier deals the cards, explains each draw, and pays out the winners.

title: Garage to Glory
summary: A comedy band-career game. You're the drummer who started the band: play the gigs as rhythm games and steer the band through ten years, from your parents' garage in Saskatoon to arenas around the world, or a breakup in a parking lot.

title: Outpost
summary: A first-person survival mystery. Keep an arctic weather station running for five nights: the generator, battery and heater fail on their own, the weather needs logging every two hours, and the last keeper's logbook slowly reveals what happened to them.

title: Season Ticket
summary: A soccer club management game set in Valmere, a made-up northern country. Own a club in the 16-team Kestrel Football League: run the business, build the squad and change tactics mid-match. For now you can sim a full season and the playoffs.
latest: The league plays a full season

title: AI Trading Journal
summary: My market views, the trades I take, and my running record, with notes from an AI coach on what to keep doing and what to fix.

title: Agent Fleet
summary: A set of small, single-purpose bots I can run from my phone, like news digests, trackers, and weekly scans.
